desc: Implement the order-ideal dominance check in \(O(M\log M)\), including parsing and output.

Prove that every valid coloring has a coordinatewise downward-closed black set, and that absence of black-to-white dominance conflicts makes the downward closure of prescribed black cells a valid completion.
Verify edge cases: same-row conflicts, same-column conflicts, all-white/all-black observations, and \(N=1\).
